THE INITIATIVE LAUNCHED AT THE WHITE HOUSE · JULY 2025

In July 2025, the White House and CMS launched the Health Tech Ecosystem initiative, calling on the private sector to make health data work for patients: interoperable, secure, and personal. Companies pledged; CMS tracked delivery.

One year later, InPursuit is among the companies recognized for shipping. Not a commitment, not a criteria phase: General Availability, independently reviewed, and operating today.

THREE FEDERAL PRIORITIES · ONE INFRASTRUCTURE
01

Patients own their record

The Administration's clipboard-free vision is the InPursuit starting point: every provider, lab, and payer assembled into one record the person owns, protected by the InPursuit Data Oath and shared only when they choose.

02

AI that works for one person

The InPursuit Orchestration Layer runs any AI, not only our own, routing each person to the best model for their condition and returning recommendations written for one person, citing their own numbers.

03

Chronic care that reaches patients

InPursuit Reflect captures FDA cleared vitals in a fifty-second scan, and the same infrastructure lets independent practices furnish and bill the monitoring and chronic care they could never staff.

THE QUALITY CREDENTIAL CMS SELECTED

The DiMe Seal was awarded to the InPursuit Health App in July 2026, valid through July 2027. It is the independent review credential CMS selected for entry into the Medicare App Library, and it sits alongside the security posture the record runs on.

FEDERAL RECOGNITION · JULY 27, 2026

Recognized by CMS, in every category we pledged.

At America's Health Data Freedom Day, the one-year anniversary of the CMS Health Tech Ecosystem, InPursuit Health, LLC was presented a Certificate of Recognition for achieving General Availability, signed by the Administrator of CMS. InPursuit earned recognition across all three of its pledged categories, was featured in the CMS showcase alongside Apple, Oura, and MEDITECH, and is listed in the CMS Pledge Demo Showcase on CMS.gov, with five of the eight newly announced pledge categories already live in the InPursuit Health App.
